title: Constructed regional photovoltaic generation fields improve ultra-short-term distributed solar forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.16110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ultra-short-term forecasting of densely distributed photovoltaic (PV) systems remains challenging because external meteorological and satellite products may not adequately resolve rapid local variations, while heterogeneous PV systems exhibit different generation responses under similar atmospheric conditions. Meanwhile, dense PV fleets provide spatially distributed measurements that reveal regional generation dynamics. Here, we reformulate fleet-level PV forecasting from modeling discrete station time series to predicting explicit, spatially structured regional PV generation fields. We develop SatPV-Field, a regional-to-local forecasting framework that transforms distributed PV measurements into image-like generation fields and models their spatiotemporal evolution. By combining historical PV fields with satellite-derived future shortwave radiation guidance and meteorological forecasts, the framework predicts future regional generation

translated_title: 构建的区域光伏发电场改进超短期分布式太阳能预测
translated_abstract: 密集分布的光伏（PV）系统的超短期预测仍然具有挑战性，因为外部气象和卫星产品可能无法充分解析快速的局地变化，而异构的光伏系统在相似的大气条件下会表现出不同的发电响应。与此同时，密集的光伏集群提供了空间分布的测量数据，能够揭示区域发电动态。本文中，我们将集群级光伏预测从对离散站点时间序列的建模，重新构建为对显式的、空间结构化的区域光伏发电场的预测。我们开发了SatPV-Field，一个从区域到本地的预测框架，它将分布式光伏测量数据转换为图像式的发电场，并对其时空演化进行建模。通过将历史光伏发电场与卫星反演的未来短波辐射引导信息以及气象预报相结合，该框架能够预测未来的区域发电情况。
tldr: 该论文提出SatPV-Field框架，将密集分布光伏电站的离散测量数据重构为图像式的区域发电场，并结合卫星短波辐射与气象预报建模其时空演化，从而提升超短期分布式光伏发电预测的精度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SatPV-Field, a regional-to-local framework that transforms discrete distributed PV measurements into image-like regional generation fields and models their spatiotemporal evolution with satellite-derived shortwave radiation and meteorological guidance, improving ultra-short-term distributed solar forecasting.
